cards.name: No Rest for the Wicked
cards.oracleText: Sacrifice this enchantment: Return to your hand all creature cards in your graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn.

cards.name: No-Regrets Egret
cards.oracleText:
Flying
Any time you could mulligan and No-Regrets Egret is in your hand, you may reveal No-Regrets Egret. If you do, look at the top two cards of your library. (Put those cards back in the same order. You can still mulligan.)
